segments.name: Cryptocurrency Mining
segments.description: Cryptocurrency mining business that deployed mining machines and holds cryptocurrencies as assets.
segments.evidence: Prior to termination, the Group deployed total of 2,094 mining machines with a total hash rate of 188,460 TH.

segments.name: Online game services

revenueModel.text: Customers in Greater China, Asia/Eastern Europe and North America pay the Group, generating its revenue from the two segments.
